== Build notes ==
Split from [[Interviews]] 16 October 2026. Guest rule: a named guest sitting down to discuss SWCCG. Chronological within three sections: game designers and Decipher employees; players; collectors.

Host catalogs stay exhaustive ([[Corran on the Horn]], [[BoardMatt]], [[PDS2 interviews]], [[Holotheatre]], [[Radio Free Decipher]], [[The Booster Pack]], NanashiStudios on [[Brandon Baity]]). The list is the union of those catalogs.

== Missing data ==
* MPC 2019 player interviews (about 17) are named on [[Podcasts, video and interviews]] and are not yet listed as individual videos on the wiki.
* 2024 Retro Event interviews (Renegade Squadron) and Massassi Training Temple Naboo Regionals interviews are named on the podcasts directory without per-video rows.
* [[Corran on the Horn]] event specials with a blank Guest cell (Indiana Super Weekend, Nationals 2023, Worlds 2023, Indianapolis, Planet Pittsburgh, Nationals Audio Diaries) are omitted.
* [[Radio Free Decipher]] has a full episode table; the list includes the SWCCG interview broadcasts already singled out plus named player call-ins, not every weekly show.
* [[Holotheatre]] has 204 uploads; rows here are episodes billed as interviews, Attack of the Designers, or with a named guest besides the regular hosts.
* Films ([[One With The Force]], [[Turning Point]]) stay on the documentaries list.
